reasoning: A downward arrow pointing to a horizontal bar is the universal symbol for downloading or saving locally. It is a great action icon when the whole point of a task is pulling files, statements, installers, or archives before a link expires or a connection drops, though when a specific object like a map or audiobook dominates the title, that object's icon is even better.
